core_philosophy.title: Human Civilization Knowledge Platform
core_philosophy.description: Chorn Planet begins with human needs, industries, and real-world problems, then connects them to future solutions, Future Civilization Roadmap milestones, enabling technologies, and supporting knowledge. Technology is treated as the solution, while human civilization remains the central purpose.

content_principles.human_first: Start with what humans, families, communities, cities, rural areas, and businesses currently need.
content_principles.problem_driven: Every major content path should identify a real problem, limitation, risk, or unmet need.
content_principles.solution_oriented: Future solutions should explain how society and businesses can improve rather than only describing technology.
content_principles.roadmap_connected: Every relevant solution should connect to one or more Era 1-8 roadmap items.
content_principles.technology_as_solution: AI, robotics, biotechnology, energy, materials, and other technologies support human goals rather than becoming the central purpose.
content_principles.business_connected: Content should connect future developments to industries, operating models, jobs, investment opportunities, and business transformation.
content_principles.graph_first: Every page should be a reusable node connected through typed relationships inside the Civilization Graph Database.
content_principles.multilingual: All canonical content nodes should support the 10 Chorn Planet languages.
content_principles.quality_over_volume: New URLs should add a distinct search intent, useful explanation, or graph relationship.

phase2.description: Create 20 permanent top-level domains representing the major systems of human life, society, business, and civilization.

domains.title: Family & Society
domains.description: Family development, parenting, relationships, loneliness, aging, social connection, and community support.

domains.title: Education & Learning
domains.description: Schools, universities, lifelong learning, skills development, personal tutoring, and accessible education.

domains.title: Healthcare & Longevity
domains.description: Healthcare delivery, preventive care, mental health, rehabilitation, healthy aging, and life extension.

domains.title: Food, Agriculture & Nutrition
domains.description: Food production, restaurants, nutrition, food security, farming, supply chains, and future food systems.

domains.title: Housing & Real Estate
domains.description: Homes, apartments, property development, architecture, construction, property management, and future living.

domains.title: Cities & Communities
domains.description: Urban development, rural communities, public spaces, infrastructure, smart cities, and social inclusion.

domains.title: Transportation & Mobility
domains.description: Public transport, personal mobility, logistics, autonomous vehicles, aviation, marine transport, and accessibility.

domains.title: Energy & Utilities
domains.description: Electricity, water, waste, heating, cooling, storage, distributed energy, and future utility systems.

domains.title: Environment, Wildlife & Climate
domains.description: Climate protection, biodiversity, wildlife, pollution, conservation, restoration, and planetary resilience.

domains.title: Economy & Finance
domains.description: Economic systems, banking, digital finance, employment, investment, trade, affordability, and future prosperity.

domains.title: Work & Future Careers
domains.description: Employment, human-AI collaboration, future professions, workplace design, skills, and economic participation.

domains.title: Manufacturing & Industry
domains.description: Factories, automation, industrial systems, supply chains, production efficiency, and advanced manufacturing.

domains.title: Retail & Commerce
domains.description: Shopping, marketplaces, customer experience, payments, delivery, digital commerce, and future retail.

domains.title: Hospitality, Wellness & Tourism
domains.description: Hotels, resorts, spas, restaurants, tourism, wellness retreats, destination development, and exploration.

domains.title: Government & Public Services
domains.description: Public administration, healthcare access, education systems, digital identity, infrastructure, and civic services.

domains.title: Safety, Security & Resilience
domains.description: Personal safety, cybersecurity, disaster response, infrastructure resilience, defense, and risk management.

domains.title: Science & Research
domains.description: Scientific discovery, laboratories, research systems, physics, chemistry, biology, and interdisciplinary innovation.

domains.title: Space Civilization
domains.description: Orbital infrastructure, lunar settlements, Mars development, space industry, exploration, and interplanetary society.

domains.title: Arts, Culture & Entertainment

domains.title: Lifestyle & Human Experience
domains.description: Daily living, recreation, sports, fashion, personal development, relationships, well-being, and quality of life.

phase3.description: Expand each Human Civilization Domain into focused sub-domains representing industries, services, social systems, environments, and lifestyle activities.

phase4.description: Create pages for current problems faced by individuals, families, communities, businesses, industries, cities, rural areas, and public systems.

phase5.description: Create solution-focused pages explaining how future systems, business models, social innovations, and technologies can solve current human and industry problems.

phase6.description: Connect future solutions to the existing Era 1-8 roadmap items and continuously add new milestones as civilization develops.

phase7.description: Create technology pages only when they enable a human, business, social, scientific, or civilization-level solution.

phase8.description: Build supporting knowledge pages that explain the scientific, social, economic, ethical, cultural, and engineering foundations behind the graph.

supporting_graph_nodes.description: Add supporting node families that strengthen SEO, business relevance, discovery, and graph relationships.

enterprise_goal.description: Scale Chorn Planet through structured graph nodes, useful search intents, multilingual content, and meaningful relationships rather than generating disconnected pages.

cgd_relationships.description: Canonical relationship types for the Civilization Graph Database.

page_generation_rules.canonical_rule: One canonical node should represent one distinct concept or search intent.
page_generation_rules.translation_rule: Translations should reuse the same canonical node ID and graph relationships.
page_generation_rules.duplicate_rule: Do not create separate nodes when only wording changes but the meaning remains the same.
page_generation_rules.thin_content_rule: Do not publish a page unless it provides unique context, relationships, or useful information.

utility_platform.description: Transform graph data into useful tools that help people and businesses understand their current challenges and prepare for the future.

features.title: Industry Future Explorer
features.description: Shows current problems, future solutions, roadmap milestones, technologies, and opportunities for an industry.

features.title: Human Challenge Explorer
features.description: Allows users to explore challenges such as loneliness, aging, education inequality, healthcare access, and climate risk.

features.title: Future Solution Finder
features.description: Matches a human or business problem with related solutions, technologies, and roadmap items.

features.title: Business Opportunity Finder
features.description: Identifies products, services, markets, and operating models created by future changes.

features.title: Future Readiness Assessment
features.description: Assesses how prepared a business, city, community, or industry is for future changes.

features.title: Civilization Path Explorer
features.description: Explains how humanity can move from present conditions through Era 1-8.

features.title: AI Civilization Search
features.description: Answers questions using CGD relationships and Chorn Planet content.

features.title: Personal Future Dashboard
features.description: Allows users to follow industries, problems, solutions, technologies, and roadmap milestones.

content_metrics: Pages with three or more inbound internal links
